rationale: The agent performed order-changing actions without authenticating the user, did not confirm changes before executing them, and did not check shipping status before modifying the jigsaw order as the user requested. There is no evidence of tool calls to verify or correct the user’s address or order addresses, nor to change the item or process a refund. The agent also asserted a completed change and refund without tool-backed confirmation. These violate the policy requirements to authenticate, confirm before writes, act on supported info, and handle all requested tasks.
